description: The quantum workload agent card extension this registry checks cards against: its URI, version, spec name and JSON Schema, and this frame's QUANTUM_WORKLOADS_MODE. A provider can validate an extension it generates from its own device description against these bytes. Public. Listed where this registry's QUANTUM_WORKLOADS_MODE is shadow or on; under off it answers the switch's sentence.
name: theprotocol_getQuantumWorkloadSchema
title: Get Quantum Workload Schema
